stemMd: For which positive $c$ is $y=c$ tangent to $x^2+y^2=49$?
explanationMd: A horizontal tangent is one radius above or below the center. Substitution gives $x^2=49-c^2$, which has exactly one solution when c=7 or -7; positivity selects 7.

distractorRationale.a: The diameter line cuts the circle twice.
distractorRationale.c: Uses the diameter instead of radius.
